modules.name: Sequencer
modules.description: The OP-Z's front panel and master: eight tracks of 16 steps with micro timing, step components, live and step recording, a mixer and ten project slots

modules.name: Drum
modules.description: The OP-Z's drum tracks: a 24-sound kit per track, synthesized or loaded from OP-1 and OP-Z kits, AIFF and WAV files, with the drum note styles

modules.name: Digital
modules.description: The OP-Z's raw digital FM engine on a full synth track: filter, envelope, LFO, note styles and portamento

modules.name: Analog
modules.description: The OP-Z's subtractive engine, saw, sub and noise through an enveloped low-pass, on a full synth track

modules.name: Cluster
modules.description: The OP-Z's clustered oscillators, seven detuned saws per note, on a full synth track

modules.name: Organ
modules.description: The OP-Z's FM organ, eight algorithms from drawbars to reeds and bells, on a full synth track

modules.name: Bow
modules.description: The OP-Z's string synthesis, a bowed string waveguide with a second string for chorus, on a full synth track

modules.name: Electric
modules.description: The OP-Z's complex and transforming engine, two sines modulating each other, on a full synth track

modules.name: Saw
modules.description: The OP-Z's filtered waves, two saws through an enveloped resonant low-pass, on a full synth track

modules.name: Shade
modules.description: The OP-Z's smooth piano, a soft FM electric piano with detune and drive, on a full synth track

modules.name: Uranus
modules.description: The OP-Z's clean bass, a sine operator with harmonics and feedback, on a full synth track

modules.name: Volt
modules.description: The OP-Z's multi-oscillator engine, saw, pulse and sub with width and ring modulation, on a full synth track

modules.name: EP
modules.description: The OP-Z's FM electric piano, eight algorithms from tines and reeds to bells and a toy, on a full synth track

modules.name: Synth Breakout
modules.description: An OP-Z synth track for a voice made of other modules: pitch, gate, envelope, LFO and dials out, the sound back in through its filter and envelope

modules.name: Drum Breakout
modules.description: An OP-Z drum track for sounds made of other modules: trigger, gate, sound, velocity, envelope, LFO and dials out, the sound back in through its filter and envelope

modules.name: Send FX Breakout
modules.description: An OP-Z FX track for an effect made of other modules: the send, notes, time, LFO and dials out, the effect back in through its filter and level

modules.name: Delay
modules.description: The OP-Z's digital delay as a send effect on an FX track: time from the keys, in tempo, with feedback and damping

modules.name: Reverb
modules.description: The OP-Z's clean, lightly modulated reverb as a send effect on an FX track: a plate with decay, tone and predelay from the keys

modules.name: Rymd
modules.description: The OP-Z's older digital reverb as a send effect on an FX track: a room with size and damping

modules.name: Chorus-80
modules.description: The OP-Z's old-school chorus as a send effect on an FX track: a swept stereo bucket-brigade chorus

modules.name: Crush
modules.description: The OP-Z's crusher as a send effect on an FX track: sample rate and bit reduction with a low-pass after

modules.name: Dist
modules.description: The OP-Z's overdrive as a send effect on an FX track: oversampled soft clipping with a tone control

modules.name: Screen
modules.description: The OP-Z's phone app as an expander: place it to the right of an OP-Z engine to see its pages, its sound and every dial, and to edit them by touch
